about.label: ABOUT US
about.title: INVIK SA, your trusted online banking partner
about.p1: INVIK SA is an innovative online bank dedicated to offering secure, fast, and simple financial services. Combining cutting-edge technology and banking expertise, we are committed to making managing your finances more accessible and secure, whether you are in France or abroad.
about.p2: Our goal is to simplify the banking experience for our clients, with competitive fees, 24/7 customer support, and personalized solutions tailored to your needs.
about.p3: At INVIK SA, we believe in a financial future where technology simplifies every step of your banking experience. By staying at the forefront of innovation, we are determined to offer services ever more adapted to the expectations of a modern and connected clientele. Trust INVIK SA to evolve with you, today and tomorrow.

history.title: Our History
history.p1: Founded in 2009 in Luxembourg, INVIK SA was born from a bold vision to redefine the banking experience for the digital age. Our founders, experts in finance and technology, identified a crucial need: offering modern banking services without compromising security or human relationships.
history.p2: Since our beginnings, we have experienced remarkable growth, going from a few hundred clients to over 500,000 active users across Europe. This expansion testifies to our constant commitment to innovation and customer service excellence.
history.p3: Today, INVIK SA is recognized as one of the most reliable and innovative online banks in Europe, with an established presence in Luxembourg, France, Belgium, and Germany.

items.question: How can I open an account with INVIK SA?
items.answer: To open an account, go to our registration page, complete the form with your personal information, then follow the steps to verify your identity and validate your file.

items.question: How can I make an international transfer?
items.answer: International transfers are made from your client area by choosing the "International Transfer" option. Enter your beneficiary's details, the amount and currency, then validate the operation after verifying the information.

items.question: What documents are required for account opening?
items.answer: You will generally need a valid ID (passport, ID card) and proof of address less than three months old. Additional documents may be requested depending on your situation.

items.question: Is my information secure at INVIK SA?
items.answer: Yes. INVIK SA uses advanced encryption technologies and security protocols to protect your personal and financial data, as well as your online operations.

items.question: How can I order an INVIK SA bank card?
items.answer: Once your account is open, you can request a bank card directly from your online client area, in the "My Cards" section, then follow the instructions for ordering and activation.

items.question: What are the payment and withdrawal limits of my INVIK SA cards?
items.answer: Each INVIK SA card has default payment and withdrawal limits (per day and/or month). These limits may vary depending on your profile, card type, and history. You can view and adjust your limits, up to authorized amounts, directly from your client area or our app.

items.question: Does INVIK SA offer loan solutions?
items.answer: Yes, INVIK SA offers several types of loans, including personal loans and financing solutions adapted to your projects, subject to conditions and acceptance. Consult our "Our Services" page for more details.

items.question: What are the withdrawal fees at ATMs?
items.answer: Withdrawals may be free up to a certain amount or number of operations per month, then charged according to the current fee schedule. Fees may differ between withdrawals made in the Eurozone and internationally. Consult the "Rates" section of your client area.

items.question: What fees are associated with INVIK SA accounts?
items.answer: Our fees are designed to be transparent and competitive. You can consult all rates (account maintenance, cards, operations, etc.) on our dedicated fee schedule page.

items.question: How to contact INVIK SA customer service?
items.answer: Our customer service is available to assist you. You can contact us by phone, email, or via the contact form or online chat, according to the channels indicated on our "Contact" page.

items.question: Can I manage my INVIK SA account from a mobile?
items.answer: Yes, our platform is optimized for use on mobile, tablet, and computer. You can view your balances, track your operations, and manage your services wherever you are.

items.question: What to do if my INVIK SA card is lost or stolen?
items.answer: In case of loss or theft, immediately block your card from your client area, if available, and/or contact our customer service immediately to oppose the card and request a replacement.

items.question: Which countries are eligible for a credit at INVIK bank?
items.answer: INVIK bank offers credits to residents of all European countries (Eurozone, EU, Switzerland, UK, etc.) and Americas (USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, etc.). To be eligible, you must have a valid passport, prove identity, and justify regular income.
